contracts_revalidated: All9 changed paths fully read from Git6b, including full renderer production and existing fixture (initial long-output truncation repaired by bounded540-1540 source reread). Full atlas layout/paint/mip/uploader ownership covered. CardMesh production method exact parent; changed mixed fixture only one existing case with exact numeric recipe4/32/128/seed1 and same assertions after API inverse. No test execution or new oracle.

AtlasVariantCount rejects0; AtlasTileSpan rejects0 and uses actual i32::try_from cause for signed raster modulus/height addresses. Positive tile and variant leaves are private, AtlasSettings composite public fields carry these checked owners. Default8/64x256 and transparent1/1x1 use private admitted catalog leaves. Recipe can have native/full width overflow only at composite layout, where checked_mul rejects before allocation.

AtlasMipLayout admits full atlas width=tilewidth*variants, height, full bytes_per_row=width*sizeof(RgbaTexel) in u32, positive extents, u64 pixel product narrowed to usize, checked byte product and isize addressability. Tile layout is separately admitted. This proves host row/index/stitch extents, each f32 working image byte capacity and height*2 step arithmetic. Smaller dimensions monotonically shrink, so their native row/host products cannot overflow the parent proof. zeroed<T> uses actual try_reserve_exact error then nonallocating resize_with for private known-default arrays/Vecs.

CardAtlas holds required base plus private smaller Vec, private immutable settings, private mip layout/pixels; no public mutation or missing first level can diverge dimensions/pixels/variant count. AtlasMip read-only getters and pixel_bytes cast expose actual contiguous [u8;4] data. All owned large allocations (base, columns, coverage, shade, depth, output, smaller levels) preserve TryReserveError/host integer causes through AtlasError. Parallel failure returns no CardAtlas candidate; per-variant buffers drop normally. This is not a guarantee against arbitrary allocator/provider internal failure.

Deterministic paint preserves old per-variant seed word seed XOR(v*0x9E37), canonical Seed::xor_word is exact XOR and to_u64 returns same word. u32 variant product fitsu64; enumerate cannot exceed admitted count. Rng SplitMix initialization/advance and every index/range/next_f32 call order unchanged. Parallel per-column ordering uses enumerated fixed mutable slots rather than completion order; each column stitches its original row range. Raster path, steps, wrapping, coverage winner, tone/depth and byte rounding/truncation are source-equivalent for every previously successful bounded input; only indexing uses admitted hostusize addresses.

2x2 downsample reads identical four clamped neighbor coordinates, sums each u8 channel in u32 (<=1020), rounds(sum+2)/4 to u8 and retains channel order coverage/shade/depth/coverage. Odd extents retain original floor-halving behavior. Loop has one required base, appends at most11 smaller levels and stops if either axis<=1; it does not extend formerly shorter chains to both-axis1. Native extent floor-shift and max-mip SDK rules match each actual mip; count1..12 never exceeds full-chain max for admitted dimensions.

UploadedAtlas first checks actual base dimensions against device.max_texture_dimension_2d and converts canonical PixelFormat::Rgba8Unorm via Color::to_wgpu; Color ChannelLayout::Rgba.channels() owns four-channel array shape. Feature edge color/wgpu undergpu makes adapter available only where needed. Every copy uses actual mip extent,row bytes,height,data and ordinal bounded12, with D2/layer1/sample1/COPY_DST|TEXTURE_BINDING. Queue::write_texture does not require encoder-style256-row alignment; admitted tight rows remain valid. Native device/queue pairing and provider-handled validation policy unchanged; no global native-health verdict.

UploadedAtlas owns native view+exact canonical variant count from same upload; independent renderer atlas_variants field removed. Initial transparent source is zeroRGBA1x1 with one variant. Lighting groups receive that view; Globals.mode.y extracts only that count at native shader boundary. No recomputed row/mip shape or separately mutable source population retained in this received graph.

Host set_groom now returnsResult and admits/uploads atlas before building candidate strand/card/head/groups/counts/bounds, then publishes allscene fields and invalidates view. GPU set_gpu_groom preserves foreign-device/head/source/cover guards, builds native candidates and atlasResult before logical publication. Atlas admission failure leaves prior logical scene/mean intact; submitted native writes target new private atlas and preserve existing device policy. Remaining native strand/card/sim admission is not silently certified by this candidate ordering.

04 documentation edits are source-accurate: CPU smoothing prose describes present behavior; set_head distinguishes native allocation handling and old-head preservation on malformed layout; set_gpu_groom documents actual device/source/exactbytes/Nonebare/admission semantics. Its non-doc head source bytes remain exact, prior typedcause/head identity contracts unchanged. Current renderer temporal/finite input/convergence/draw-prefix/head/readback relationships reread and unchanged by atlas publication.
